events.evidence: Two people are killed and eight others are injured in a Houthi attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia
The U.S. Department of State orders non-emergency employees at its embassy in Riyadh to leave the country as Houthi attacks ramp up
Two people are killed and two others are injured by debris after a suspected Houthi drone is shot down near Shaybah oil field

label.note: Houthi attacks hit Saudi airport and oil field; US embassy drawdown; Middle East risk elevated.
